name: Sam Scull

bio.statement: The City of Wilsonville directory page says Sam Scull was appointed to the City Council on Oct. 20, 2025, and sworn in Nov. 3, 2025, for a term through December 2026.
bio.excerpt: Sam Scull was appointed to the City Council on Oct. 20, 2025

source.publisher: City of Wilsonville, Councilor Sam Scull directory page

bio.statement: The city page says Scull previously served on the Planning Commission, Development Review Board and Budget Committee.

source.publisher: City of Wilsonville, Councilor Sam Scull directory page

collection_notes: Pamphlet p. 57 (C-56): Scull left column, Scritsmier right. His Measure 3-641 argument is PDF p. 69 (C-68). Appointed to a vacancy (Dunwell's seat), term through Dec 2026. City elections page says the two seats up are those of Council President Caroline Berry and Scull; Berry is not in the inventory candidate list (not filed/withdrawn? unverified) - possible inventory discrepancy. Index extract lists p. 69, 73 for Scull; p. 73 is another 3-641 page with no separate Scull statement.
